status: proposed default, not agreed with Luke and Liza

tests: Accepted on a council or government contract
partner_screen.rule: Every test must pass for Stable partner. Any fail is Weak. A gap with no fail is Candidate. The tests are not weighted against each other.

covenant_points_in_operator_scoring.note: These points are the only number the current operator screen takes from the partner result.

operator_market_score.note: Already on the operator screen. The total is halved where presence in that council is unconfirmed. These weights are not changed here.

proposed.label: Proposed partner score for review

rationale.financial_health: Profit and the balance sheet are the covenant behind a guaranteed rent. They take the largest share, split evenly between profit and net assets inside this heading.
rationale.ownership: A board or a regulated parent is what makes the accounts usable. Owner-managed companies with a thin board stay easier to fail.
rationale.company_size: Revenue and headcount show whether the partner can actually manage homes. They sit together so a large registered provider is not marked small only because headcount was omitted from a filing.
rationale.contracts: A council or government contract is evidence the partner is already accepted, not evidence of spare capacity.
rationale.trading_history: A short trading life is a real risk, but it should not wipe out a strong balance sheet the way the current all-or-nothing gate does.

proposed.scoring: A pass scores the full weight. A disclosed gap scores half. A fail scores nothing. The result is shown out of 100. If the weights are edited and no longer sum to 100, the score is scaled back to 100 so the screen stays comparable.
proposed.not_final: Do not use these bands or weights in a bid or a credit decision until Luke and Liza have agreed them.
